scope: MEDIUM-2 M2.1 JOURNAL REPLACEMENT AND CRASH RECOVERY

unresolved_risks.pre_intent_leaf_birth: A crash after mkdirat but before durable temp publication leaves a cgroup with no original intent. Current sweep refuses adoption; manual quarantine/cleanup required.
unresolved_risks.temp_written_before_rename: A canonical fsynced temp may allow tightly bound sweep; crash durability of the directory entry and parent cgroup birth is not independently established.
unresolved_risks.rename_before_directory_fsync: A crash can leave intent.v1 or intent.tmp or neither depending on filesystem persistence; no automatic inference of authorization from filename.
unresolved_risks.record_validation_before_unlink: Canonical contents and record equality do not atomically bind unlinkat to the verified inode; replacement requires independent writer-exclusion proof.
unresolved_risks.leaf_deleted_before_record_cleanup: Failure/crash can leave intent.v1 referencing an absent leaf; subsequent recover must quarantine rather than declare success without an owned leaf.
unresolved_risks.post_unlink_before_directory_fsync: Deletion can be rolled back by crash or leave partial records; replay must validate original durable authority and refuse ambiguous state.
unresolved_risks.cooperating_lock_only: flock serializes cooperating participants, not all privileged or alternate-mount writers.
